nodes.label: Conservative migration identity matching

nodes.label: Pluggable media ingestion

nodes.label: Pluggable extraction pipeline

nodes.label: SSRF Safe Web Ingestion

nodes.label: Project Scoped Workflows

nodes.label: Safe Project Open

Backend-owned project safety
nodes.rationale: Registered project contexts, backend-held confirmations, Git checkpoints, and cancellable TaskService work prevent a frontend request from authorizing unsafe local mutations.

nodes.label: Truthful persisted Agent state
nodes.rationale: Import duplicate detection ignores derived extracted artifacts while SettingsService keeps visible default-Agent configuration aligned with Chat execution state and terminal failures.

nodes.label: Accessible compact application shell
nodes.rationale: The shell centralizes right-context panel state, modal focus handling, responsive constraints, button tokens, and reduced-motion behavior rather than duplicating them across views.

nodes.label: Authorized Chat convenience actions
nodes.rationale: Convenience-mode Chat requires backend authorization, intent classification, auditable diff inputs, rollback helpers, and explicit Agent invocation integration.

nodes.label: Recoverable chat sessions
nodes.rationale: Chat opening restores or selects a session, separates page-scoped assistant sessions, and keeps send, scrolling, citation, and save actions non-destructive.

nodes.label: Single-flight graph rebuild UX
nodes.rationale: Graph rebuilding has explicit UI state, one active rebuild, in-view progress, localized retry, and backend task-semantics verification.

nodes.label: Local and hosted validation contract
nodes.rationale: CI/CD pins a shared validation contract and verifies it both locally and in hosted automation before review.

nodes.label: Combined AI configuration
nodes.rationale: Settings consolidates AI configuration with component tests, branded provider presentation, and polish for secondary settings sections.

nodes.label: Controller-owned AppShell workflows
nodes.rationale: Dedicated capability, task-launcher, import, provider, Agent, confirmation, and workspace controllers keep AppShell thin and make error/data flows explicit.

nodes.label: Stable service facades
nodes.rationale: Import, search, lint, and Chat capabilities are split by use case behind stable facades so commands and cross-service contracts do not become ad hoc coupling.

nodes.label: Living architecture documentation
nodes.rationale: Product, app-flow, backend, frontend, roadmap, and implementation documentation must reflect the current architecture and completed milestones rather than obsolete plans.

nodes.label: Recoverable Import V2 sessions
nodes.rationale: Import V2 centers typed DTOs, session persistence, capability-protocol engines, immutable source planning, quality gates, TaskService orchestration, and per-item atomic commits.

nodes.label: Non-reflow sidebar and theme shell
nodes.rationale: Focused failure tests lock scroll and non-reflow behavior before minimal layout, scrollbar, and theme changes are verified.

nodes.label: Sanitized Import V2 Agent assistance
nodes.rationale: Item-scoped sanitized workspaces, tool brokering, local cancellation, BYOK approval/scope audit, candidate validation, diff review, and recovery delimit optional Agent assistance.

nodes.label: Bounded local file ingestion
nodes.rationale: File ingestion uses a golden corpus, signed capability packs, bounded discovery, explicit format routes, isolated legacy conversion, OCR/ASR gates, and recoverable progress.

nodes.label: Recoverable Import V2 workbench
nodes.rationale: The frontend presents two entry panes, a persistent queue, item actions, session/task workflow state, source-quality inspection, assistance gates, and legacy history without replacing safety decisions.

nodes.label: Read-only migration and controlled cutover
nodes.rationale: Legacy migration inventories and correlates data read-only, shows a stable dry run, applies through Core transactions with recovery, shadows verification, and retires legacy mutations only after a soak period.

nodes.label: Restricted open-source ingestion routes
nodes.rationale: Candidate libraries and reuse paths are selected against product decision rules; unsupported or unsafe approaches remain explicitly rejected or restricted.

nodes.label: Bounded web ingestion
nodes.rationale: Web import combines canonical URLs, SSRF policy, bounded fetching, redirect/rate ledgers, sanitization, typed domain routing, isolated login sessions, and connector-specific release gates.

nodes.label: Reusable import remediation prompts
nodes.rationale: A shared prompt template and per-batch substitutions make remediation work consistent while allowing specific batches to add required constraints.

nodes.label: Gated Import Source Media remediation
nodes.rationale: Nine remediation batches close specific findings while preserving fixed contracts for source finalization, compile bridge, local discovery, media, web, workbench, reader, AI organization, and compatibility gates.

nodes.label: Project-scoped observable workflow queue
nodes.rationale: Workflows persist a project-scoped queue, resolve routes and prerequisites, expose typed task pipelines, centralize launch/confirmation/cancellation/retry, and replace the legacy Agent main surface.

nodes.label: Authoritative first-run and Workflow closure
nodes.rationale: The v2 closure plan makes current first-run authority and honest Batch 8 evidence primary, sequencing path safety, layout, trust, assessment, Workflows consumption, and release gates.

nodes.label: Handle-safe project writes
nodes.rationale: Canonical path validation and app-level locks do not close cross-process TOCTOU; release requires descriptor or handle-anchored no-follow writes, deletes, renames, and rollbacks.
